query: Beatform builds fine on my machine, I think the shader tweak is done - can I call it finished?
reason: Claiming completion is exactly the trigger; the repo gate set plus the GPU device gate must run first.
expected_routing: Read GATES.md, run the five web gates plus the cargo --workspace gates, run test:gpu because a shader changed, quote each result.

query: The audio tests keep timing out when I run the whole suite - can we bump the retries?
reason: Flaky-looking test failure; the anti-flake protocol forbids reruns and demands a describe-level timeout budget instead.
expected_routing: Refuse rerun/retry; diagnose the default per-test timeout, add an explicit describe budget with a written reason, then rerun the real gate.

query: cargo test passes in src-tauri, so the Rust side is green.
reason: Bare cargo silently skips workspace members; the claim needs verification with --workspace.
expected_routing: Point out the missing --workspace/--all, rerun fmt/clippy/test with it, report the real result.

query: CI is red on format:check but everything passes locally. What now?
reason: Local-versus-CI disagreement is a gate-drift symptom.
expected_routing: Locate the canonical gate manifest, find which definition drifted, fix the drift in the same change rather than forking a second definition.

query: Write a new preset that renders concentric rings.
reason: Pure implementation request with no completion claim; gates apply at the end, not as the entry skill.
expected_routing: Do not lead with this skill; implement first, then run gates before claiming done.
